I'd want to see how you actually train before picking, so let me pull your recent history and your current program. Nothing is logged for you yet, so I'm going on general coaching, and the deciding factor is how many days a week you can train.

With 3 to 4 days, run upper/lower. You hit every muscle twice a week, which is the better deal for most people, and each session stays a manageable length. With 5 to 6 days, PPL works well, and it's also the better fit if you like longer, more focused sessions on one area. If you can only train 3 days, PPL hits each muscle just once a week, which is the weak spot of the split.

If you're not sure, I'd pick upper/lower, because it's easier to keep up when life gets busy and a missed day costs you less.

How many days can you realistically train each week? Tell me that, along with how long you have per session, and I'll set up the program.
